This document describes the A level attainment in maths and science subjects for students included in attainment measures published in the 2022 16-18 performance tables broken down by gender.
The 16-18 performance tables report achievements of students aged 16 to 18 who are at the end of advanced level study, often referred to as ‘being at the end of Key Stage 5'.
16-18 study typically lasts two to three years and up to three years of results achieved by students are reported in the 2022 16-18 performance tables: ie results achieved during all years of 16-18 study (up to three years, i.e.  2019/20, 2020/21 and 2021/22 academic years)

Entries in A level maths and science:
1. Schools and colleges in England
2. A level exam results of students aged 16, 17 or 18 at the start of the academic year, ie 31 August.
3. Students at the end of 16-18 level study who were entered for at least one AS or A level.
4. Entries made during all (up to three) years of 16-18 study, eg the 2019/20, 2020/21 and 2021/22 academic years for the 2022 reporting year.

To protect confidentiality, the following conventions have been used throughout this publication:
• 0 (zero) is shown only when the true value is 0
